mentions.name: Pattern-matching board game
mentions.description: A simple browser puzzle game where the player clicks cells on an empty board to make it match a target pattern. It lacks instructions and mobile optimization, which the author may never add.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I put together a mindless game over the weekend. I haven’t added instructions or optimized it for mobile yet, and may never due to laziness. Click the empty board to make it match the pattern:

https://christophilus.com/#1l-1n-10
